items.body_raw: שָׁבַת אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מֵהַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
items.answer_raw: God rested on the seventh day from the work which he had made.

items.body_raw: The wise people rested on the seventh day.
בָּא חַיִל גָּדוֹל מִיַּרְכְּתֵי הָאָרֶץ וּמֵאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת הַשָּׁמָיִם
items.answer_raw: There came a great army from the ends of the earth and from the four winds of heaven.

items.body_raw: נָתַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַמְּאוֹרוֹת הַגְּדֹלִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמָיִם
items.answer_raw: God set the two great luminaries in the firmament of heaven.

items.body_raw: עָף אֵלַי אֶחָד מִן־הַשְּׂרָפִים וּבְיָדוֹ רִצְפָּה בְּמֶלְקָחַיִם לָקַח מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
items.answer_raw: There flew to me one of the seraphs, with a glowing stone in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

items.body_raw: שבת אלהים ביום השביעי מהמלאכה אשר עשה
items.answer_raw: God rested on the seventh day from the work which he had made.

items.body_raw: בִּשְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ נָשָׂא מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל אֶת־רֹאשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מִבֵּית כֶּלֶא
items.answer_raw: In the thirty-seventh year, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh (day) of the month, the king of Babylon lifted up the head of the king of Judah out of the prison-house.
A day in thy courts is better than a thousand.

items.body_raw: The days of the years of my life have been four and seventy years.
items.answer_raw: יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי אַרְבַּע שָׁנִים וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה
